ELIXIR_BONE.name: Elixir of Bone
ELIXIR_BONE.effect: Up to 2 faces become BONE (6 points)

ELIXIR_LEAF.name: Elixir of Leaf
ELIXIR_LEAF.lore: Smells like a forest after rain. Tastes like the ground of that forest.

ELIXIR_METAL.name: Elixir of Metal
ELIXIR_METAL.lore: Don't know how to even drink this

STRENGTH_TONIC.name: Strength Tonic
STRENGTH_TONIC.lore: Splash it on your minions to ragebait them.

WHETSTONE_OIL.name: Whetstone Oil
WHETSTONE_OIL.effect: SHARP rune on up to 2 faces

SWARM_BREW.name: Swarm Brew
SWARM_BREW.effect: SWARM rune on up to 2 faces

GLASS_DRAUGHT.name: Glass Draught
GLASS_DRAUGHT.lore: Beautiful, powerful and one bad tumble away from shattering.

IRON_DRAUGHT.name: Iron Draught
IRON_DRAUGHT.lore: You probably could use this as a weapon.

GRAVE_DUST.name: Grave Dust
GRAVE_DUST.lore: Scraped from a very old tombstone. A ghost is still loitering inside.

LIQUID_GOLD.name: Liquid Gold
LIQUID_GOLD.lore: Pour it on a dice face, no need for payday.

LUCKY_CLOVER.name: Lucky Clover
LUCKY_CLOVER.effect: LUCKY rune on up to 2 faces

MIRROR_DRAUGHT.name: Mirror Draught
MIRROR_DRAUGHT.effect: Pick 2 faces: the second becomes a copy of the first
MIRROR_DRAUGHT.lore: You need to be photogenic for your doppelganger to be strong too.

HERMIT_BREW.name: Hermit's Brew
HERMIT_BREW.lore: Brewed by a hermit who never spent a coin.
